description: Applyra dependency updates (spec 09 §8: weekly, grouped, minimumReleaseAge 3 days, Actions + image digests). Majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard (spec 04 §7.1: majors are pinned on purpose).

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors need an explicit decision (ADR / spec 04 §7.1), never an automatic PR.
npm minor/patch in one weekly PR.
GitHub Actions (SHA digests + version comments) in one PR.
Container images (compose, CI docker run, Testcontainers) in one PR; tag + digest move together.
Ryuk image tag is tied to the testcontainers release (ci.yml RYUK_CONTAINER_IMAGE): one PR for both.
Terraform (M0-17): providers + required_version (built-in terraform manager, also updates .terraform.lock.hcl) in one PR.
The CI image hashicorp/terraform (regex manager) moves with required_version: same group, after "container images" so it wins.
Reusable modules keep floor constraints (~> X.Y); only the envs/* root pins move.
Node runtime follows LTS lines only (ADR 024): even majors, via approval like any major.

customManagers.description: Images referenced as `<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` outside compose: `docker run` / env in workflows and the Testcontainers images module.
